record.dic_text:
01195 Ba`ana' {ba-a-na:'}

與 01196 同; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Baana 2, Baanah 1; 3

巴拿 = "痛苦"
1) 亞希律的兒子, 所羅門王的後勤官, 在耶斯列和約旦河谷以北之地
   負責王室所需的供應 (#王上 4:12|)
2) 所羅門王手下的另一位高官 (#王上 4:16|)
3) 撒督的父親, 撒督曾協助尼希米重建耶路撒冷城牆的工作 (#尼 3:4|)
record.edic_text:
01195 Ba`ana' {bah-an-aw'}

the same as 01196;; n pr m

AV - Baana 2, Baanah 1; 3

Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"
1) the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and
   the north of the Jordan valley
2) another of Solomon's officers
3) father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem
   under Nehemiah
